# Bartender Pro

Curated by Skill Harbor — a menu-driven AI bartender skill covering seven areas: classic and modern cocktail recipes, technique guides (shake, stir, muddle, infusion, clarification), bar setup (equipment, mise en place, workflow), menu engineering (pricing, food cost, pairing), an ingredient guide, and food-and-cocktail pairing — with responsible-service guidance throughout. Invoke it with no argument for the menu, or name a style, occasion or ingredient and it parses and acts immediately. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @aiunlocked1412. Honest caveats: bilingual Thai/English — the interface and much of the content is in Thai; ingredient availability notes are tuned for Thailand (what's imported vs. locally substitutable), so some guidance needs localizing elsewhere; broad rather than deep on any single topic. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
